facts.fact: Aadhaar enrolment is carried out by UIDAI's Registrars (mainly state governments, central ministries, banks and public sector organisations), themselves or through enrolment agencies they contract
facts.quote: Registrars shall carry the enrolment of individuals seeking to enrol by themselves or through enrolment agencies contracted by them.

facts.fact: Residents enrol at a nearby Aadhaar Enrolment Centre or Aadhaar camp
facts.quote: Individuals of all states/UTs seeking enrolment , are required to enrol only at nearby Aadhaar Enrolment Centre/Aadhaar Camps .

facts.fact: UIDAI Regional Offices each cover listed states and UTs; the Regional Offices page gives the office for each state
facts.quote: Regional Offices with the covering States and UTs under their jurisdiction are listed below

facts.fact: UIDAI's contact: toll-free 1947 and email help@uidai.gov.in

behaviour: Replies in Hinglish/Hindi; gives only what UIDAI publishes: enrolment is run by Registrars (state government etc.) and their enrolment agencies at centres/camps, so the request should go to the state Registrar or the UIDAI Regional Office for the state, or via 1947 / help@uidai.gov.in; does not invent an application procedure, form, fee or timeline for organising a camp.
fail_if: Invents a step-by-step camp application process, form, fee or guaranteed approval; gives non-official contacts.
summary: UIDAI publishes no resident procedure for requesting a camp; it says enrolment is run by Registrars/enrolment agencies at centres or camps, lists Regional Offices by state and gives 1947 / help@uidai.gov.in.
